# WEAKNESSES
*Generated by `python3 thesis_doc.py` from `out/metrics.json` (data as of 2026-11-09). Every number below is computed by code in this repository; `make verify` rebuilds them with no API key and fails if this file is out of date. Research, not investment advice.*

These are the weak points we know about, with the source of each. We would rather you read them here than find them yourself.

## W1
NearBlocks does not publish how its daily charts are computed. Accounts and transactions have no second source here. Gas fees agree with DefiLlama (data from Allium) to 0.03% over 365 days, and price with CoinGecko (`crosscheck.gas_fees_abs_diff_pct`, `crosscheck.gas_fee_days_compared`).
Source: https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts

## W2
NEAR Intents swap counts are a one-Sunday-a-week sample; see TRIPWIRES.md 'How NEAR Intents is sampled'.
Source: https://explorer.near-intents.org/api/v0/transactions, https://api.llama.fi/summary/fees/near-intents?dataType=dailyFees

## W3
The buyback record is short: 260 days since 2026-02-23, and the annual figure is the last 30 days times 365/30 (`holders.days`, `holders.annualised`).
Source: https://api.llama.fi/overview/fees/near?excludeTotalDataChart=false&excludeTotalDataChartBreakdown=true&dataType=dailyHoldersRevenue

## W4
App-fee totals depend on which apps DefiLlama lists and how it attributes their fees; an app it does not track is not counted (`apps.fees_usd_365d`).
Source: https://api.llama.fi/overview/fees/near?excludeTotalDataChart=false&excludeTotalDataChartBreakdown=false&dataType=dailyFees

## W5
Staking is not measured. This repository does not measure how much NEAR is staked or what stakers earn. New issuance is counted as a cost to all holders; part of it is paid to stakers, so the dilution figures overstate the cost to stakers and understate it for holders who do not stake (`holders.cover_of_issuance_pct`).
Source: https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts

## W6
Dollar figures flatter growth: the 30-day mean price is +102% against a year ago (`price.yoy_pct`), so we show NEAR-denominated transfer volume beside the dollar figure (`vol_near.yoy_pct`).
Source: https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts, https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/near/market_chart?vs_currency=usd&days=365&interval=daily

## W7
Thirty-day windows hide spikes and annualising 30 days assumes the pace holds; 90-day figures are in out/metrics.json under w90 (`w90.active.yoy_pct`).
Source: https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts

## W8
The judges are models, and models change: 4 judges from 4 makers, each able to cite only metric paths; two judge models were replaced on 9 Nov 2026 when Nebius retired the originals, and the replacements did not vote identically (README, 'Model retirement'). The planted false claim was caught: C20 CONTRADICTED 4/4. There is only one planted claim, so this does not measure how often a judge wrongly rejects a true claim.
Source: https://docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com/november-2026-deprecation-notice

## W9
Our position: this is a bearish thesis on valuation, entered in a hackathon run by the NEAR ecosystem, built by 3Dogs Nexus. Three tripwires (T1, T2, T3) name exactly what would flip it, on a fixed date.
Source: https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts

## W10
Fee-rate compression is not measured (Decision #2783). NEAR's Intents revenue is the fee rate charged on each swap times the volume swapped. This repository measures the fees and the revenue (`intents_daily.fees_avg_30d`, `intents_daily.revenue_avg_30d`), not the rate charged per swap. If competing cross-chain swap services push that rate down, NEAR's revenue falls even if volume holds, and the thesis rests on that revenue. No third-party fee-rate figure is quoted, because none is in the committed data.
Source: https://api.llama.fi/summary/fees/near-intents?dataType=dailyFees, https://api.llama.fi/summary/fees/near-intents?dataType=dailyRevenue
